title: ClayOM
intro: Find the effect of clay on organic matter processing.

sections.name: biomod
sections.desc:
Clay influence on organic matter from BIOMOD project. All SMB pools are af-
fected, but not the SOM pools. Additionally, the ration between maintenance and
turnover is also clay dependent. See also [Petersen et al., 2005a, Petersen et al., 2005b,
Pedersen et al., 2007]
sections.sig:
< biomod (factor factor )             ; Has default value.
                 (a a )
                 (E SMB E SMB )
                 (f SMB1 f SMB1 ) >

attrs.name: factor
attrs.doc:
(factor (0 [] 1 []) (0.25 [] 0.5 []) (1 [] 0.5 []))
      Parameter description:
      Function of clay content, multiplied to the maintenance and turnover rates of
      the SMB pools.

attrs.name: E SMB
attrs.doc:
SMB efficiency in processing organic matter. Note that you must set the
       ’efficiency’ parameter for all OM pools to this number for the BIOMOD clay
       response model to work correctly.

attrs.name: f SMB1
attrs.doc:
Fraction of AOM pools goind to SMB1. Only the fraction of AOM going to a
       SMB pool count, so this is really a fraction of the fraction coing to the SMB
       pools. Note that you must set the ’fraction’ parameter of all AOM pools to
       reflect this for the BIOMOD clay response model to work correctly.
